message:
4 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      cards.spec.ts:2 — `Cards`, imported from `./support/cards`: an object or a class, whose helpers are its members
      palette.spec.ts:3 — `default as palette`, imported from `./support/palette`: a default export, which names nothing the scanner can look into, called through as `palette.…(…)`
      rim.spec.ts:2 — `css`, imported from `./support`: a namespace a module of the corpus re-exports, called through as `css.…(…)`
      tint.spec.ts:3 — `$paint`, imported from `./support/paint`: an object or a class, whose helpers are its members, called through as `$paint.…(…)`
    Every
why: Four races read through `styleOf` as a member: of `css`, a namespace the support tree's index re-exports; of `$paint`, an object `support/paint.ts` gathers it into, called with type arguments as `$paint.rimOf<'border-color'>(…)`; of `Cards`, a page object whose readers are its methods; and of `palette`, the default export of `support/palette.ts`. A call written `css.styleOf(…)` or `cards.rimOf(2)` is a method of an object to the scanner and no helper by name, so each is refused at the import — the namespace, the object and the default once a call goes through them, the class once it is called. `visit` comes through the index's `export *`, and `boxOf` for the reference's `static.spec.ts` with it: a star re-export is followed to the file that defines the name.
